CheckTitle: AWS root account has MFA enabled for the custom baseline
CheckType: Software and Configuration Checks/AWS Security Best Practices
Software and Configuration Checks/Industry and Regulatory Standards/AWS Foundational Security Best Practices
Description: The **AWS root account** must have **multi-factor authentication** enabled under the organization's custom cloud security baseline.
Risk: Compromise of root credentials without MFA can lead to full account takeover, including data theft, billing abuse and persistent administrative access.

Code.Other: Register an MFA device for the root user in AWS Security Credentials.

Recommendation.Text: Enable MFA for the root user, preferably with a hardware authenticator, and avoid using root for daily operations.

Notes: Example check from the Prowler custom checks plug-in.
